Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the second turn of the WebSurfer), the agent incorrectly stated, "Confirmed via Wikipedia: Jean-Michel Cousteau's father is Philippe Cousteau." This is factually wrong; Jean-Michel Cousteau is the son of Jacques-Yves Cousteau, and Philippe Cousteau is actually Jean-Michel's son (and the director of the later film *Wonders of the Sea*). This error propagated confusion regarding the family lineage until it was corrected in subsequent turns.
